title: ASMR whispered deep sea creature science for deep sleep · fall asleep tonight (2 hr)
description:
A slow, whispered look at the strange animals of the deep sea: why they look the way they do, why some seem frightening and are not, how large a colossal squid really grows, and why deep fish change when they are brought up.
The voice is AI: a clone of the creator's own whisper, made with Chatterbox. The facts come from checked public sources.
2 hr of soft whispering over dim, slow footage of the real thing, no music.

Written for sleep from fact-checked How We Know scripts (howweknowdeep.com).

Picture credits
Anglerfish and Rattail: NOAA Ocean Exploration, Deep Connections 2019 (https://oceanexplorer.noaa.gov/multimedia/daily-image-media-20210801/)
